gizmo.title: Eserese site n'ederede
gizmo.description: Dee eserese dịka ederede (Mermaid): eserese usoro, usoro, ahịrị oge na ndị ọzọ. A na-ese ya na peeji nwere ederede nnọchi.

configure.title: Aha
configure.description: E gosiri n'elu eserese ahụ ma jiri ya dịka aha ya.

configure.title: Isi eserese
configure.description: Ederede Mermaid, dịka: flowchart TD, wee otu ahịrị maka njikọ ọ bụla dịka A[Draft] --> B{Ready?}. Tinye |label| mgbe akụ gasịrị iji nye ya akara aha. Eserese ahụ na-emelite ka ị na-ede.

configure.title: Ederede nnọchi
configure.description: Kọwaa ihe eserese ahụ na-egosi maka ndị na-enweghị ike ịhụ ya. Hapụ ya efu na eserese usoro ka e depụta gị nzọụkwụ ya.

configure.title: Nkọwa onyonyo
configure.description: Nkọwa onyonyo nhọrọ e gosiri n'okpuru eserese ahụ.

configure.title: Gosi isi ya
configure.description: Gosi ederede eserese ahụ n'akụkụ ihe osise ahụ.

configure.title: Gosi ederede nnọchi
configure.description: Gosi ederede nnọchi n'okpuru ihe osise ahụ. Ọ na-adị mgbe niile maka ihe ọgụgụ ihuenyo.

advanced.title: Faịlụ isi
advanced.description: Adreesị faịlụ .mmd a ga-ese kama ederede dị n'elu (https ma ọ bụ ụzọ na saịtị a).

advanced.title: Agba ntụpọ
advanced.description: Agba chip akara ngosi dị n'isi.
